title: build the reviewer's Base overlays section with the slice's own binary, or say in the brief that the installed ork predates the slice

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-211625-10ac, project ork, item S593:
